name: kudos-debug
description: Kudos: your cards, card recommendations, transactions, benefits, card-linked offers and bill negotiation

interface.longDescription: What Kudos does in ChatGPT: picks the best card in your wallet for a purchase, explains what your transactions earned, tracks unused card benefits and statement credits, finds card-linked offers, and negotiates bills (Kudos calls the provider for you).
capabilities: Recommend the best card in your wallet for a merchant
Show your card transactions and the rewards they earned
Track unused card benefits and statement credits
Negotiate a bill with your provider by phone
defaultPrompt: Which card should I use at Whole Foods?
What benefits am I not using on my cards?
Can Kudos lower my internet bill?

positive.prompt: Which card should I use at Whole Foods?
positive.expected_behavior: Ranks the wallet's cards best first for Whole Foods and explains the earn rate, plus any card-linked offer or credit that applies.

positive.description: Spending at a merchant over a date range
positive.prompt: What did I spend at Uber last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Uber transactions from last month with amounts, the card used and rewards earned, and gives the total.

positive.prompt: What benefits am I still not using on my cards?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the PENDING and NEEDS_CONFIRMATION benefits and credits per card with their value and period, and links to the Benefits Tracker.

positive.prompt: Do I have any card-linked offers at Nike?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Nike offers on the user's cards (reward, minimum spend, expiry, whether activated), or says there are none.

positive.prompt: Which bills can Kudos negotiate for me?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the providers and service types Kudos can negotiate, and offers to start a negotiation for one of them.

negative.prompt: Pay off my Amex balance with my checking account.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Kudos tool. Says Kudos can't move money or pay card balances, and offers what it can do (e.g. show recent transactions or unused benefits on the Amex card).

negative.description: General card shopping unrelated to the user's wallet
negative.prompt: Apply for the Chase Sapphire Reserve for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Kudos tool. Says Kudos can't apply for cards on the user's behalf, and offers to help with the cards already in their Kudos wallet.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Boston tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Kudos tool; the question is unrelated to Kudos.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: card recommendations, transactions, benefits tracking, card-linked offers and bill negotiation from your Kudos account.
